about.label: About
about.heading: Hi, I’m Justin.
paragraphs: I’m a Sound Editor, Mixer and Session Singer in Los Angeles. I started BURNT NEON Productions in 2025 to do the work I care about most: making *stories* and *songs* sound the way their makers imagined them.

On screen, I’ve been a Supervising Sound Editor, Re-recording Mixer, and Actor on independent films. On stage, I’ve played Melchior in Spring Awakening and Jamie in The Last Five Years. In the studio, I sing, produce and mix across Pop, Rock, R&B and Musical Theater.

services.label: Services
services.heading: What I do on a film.

items.title: Sound effects editing and design
items.text: I build the sound world your picture needs, from library effects to designed elements to custom foley recorded to picture.

items.title: Dialogue cleanup and editing
items.text: The best takes from each microphone, cleaned and blended so the cuts and clicks disappear. Room tone smoothed, volume evened.

items.title: Re-recording mixing
items.text: Dialogue, music, and effects balanced so nothing fights. Delivered at the loudness your festival or platform specifies. Stereo, 5.1, or atmos.

items.title: Spotting
items.text: You send me your initial notes on what each scene needs.

items.title: Edit and design
items.text: Dialogue cleaned and cut. Effects, ambiences and foley built. Rough mix and editorial revision rounds.

items.title: Mix
items.text: Honing the balance of all combined elements with a focused ear. Mix revisions.

items.title: Deliver
items.text: Full mix and stems exported to the formats on your delivery list.
